correctness.rationale: The planar split-skew recurrence reduces to a quadratic characteristic polynomial. Exact Schur-Cohn inequalities yield the phase boundary, the theta=1 specialization reproduces the published standard-FRB formula, and derivative analysis proves the stated global max-min reflection coefficient. Numerical root checks agree with the formulas.

originality.rationale: The parameterized reflection family, the coefficient range theta>1/2, the standard theta=1 split-skew threshold, and the pure-forward generalized-OGD slice are excluded as prior work. No checked source states the nonzero split-skew two-parameter phase diagram together with the exact robust optimizer. The full text of arXiv:2609.15936 was not inspected, which is recorded as a material residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem shows that the matched-skew obstruction defining the sharp standard-FRB constant is not robust to reflection retuning: an explicit equioscillating coefficient raises the exact split-skew ceiling by about 15.17%, creating a concrete target for sharper universal convergence or counterexample results.
